pages.title: A obra e a situação

work.title: The Tale of Peter Rabbit
work.note: Livro infantil de Beatrix Potter sobre um coelho travesso que entra na horta do Sr. McGregor. O livro mostra Peter comendo verduras e fugindo. Na aula, as crianças procuram ovos num jardim: I was looking under a bush when I found a blue egg. A cena desta aula é original; não reproduz a obra.

facts.label: Past progressive com when
facts.sub: Use was/were + -ing para a ação em andamento e when + passado simples para a ação curta: I was looking under a bush when I found a blue egg.

facts.label: Past progressive
facts.sub: Para uma ação em andamento no passado, use was/were + verbo com -ing: I was looking under a bush. They were waiting at the gate. Use was com I, he, she, it e were com os outros.

facts.label: When
facts.sub: Use when para a ação curta que aconteceu: I was looking when I found a blue egg. A ação longa fica com was/were + -ing e a curta fica no passado simples.

compare.ask: I was looking when I found it.
compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “Eu estava procurando quando achei um ovo”.
compare.tip: Diga: “I was looking when I found it.”
compare.us: Em inglês: was/were + -ing para a ação longa, e when + passado simples para a curta. Diga I was looking when I found it.

solo: Peça uma experiência pessoal do aluno com essa diferença.
group: Leia as duas colunas e peça que apontem a maior diferença.
Pergunta: I was looking when I found it.
extra90: Dupla: um fala como no Brasil, o outro como nos EUA.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: We use was/were + -ing for an action in progress.
We say “I was look under a bush.”

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: We use was/were + -ing for an action in progress. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
When shows a short action. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “I was look under a bush.” → Falso (We say I was looking.)

pages.title: A green garden · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Monday morning in a green garden in Calgary. Colorful flowers grow along the fence. Zoe sits on a bench with a basket. Her friend Finn comes in through the gate. Easter was yesterday. Finn asks about the egg hunt.
“Hi, Zoe! How was the Easter egg hunt?” says Finn. “It was fun! I was looking under a bush when I found a blue egg.” says Zoe. “Nice! What was your sister doing?” says Finn.
